concept: EBS io2: Provisioned IOPS for latency-sensitive databases
tests: Choosing an EBS type for a transactional DB with consistently high IOPS and low latency.
expected: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2 / io2 Block Express): guaranteed high IOPS and low latency. Triggers: "consistent high IOPS", "latency-sensitive transactional workload", database.
why_not: gp2 is baseline with burst, no guarantee of sustained high IOPS; st1/sc1 are HDD for throughput/cold data, not low-latency I/O.
